reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000034 (the melody read from 000034a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Christian F. Witt's dates (died 1716) are from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christian_Friedrich_Witt (c. 1660 - 13 April 1716; editor of Psalmodia sacra, Gotha 1715); CCEH's page gives none. Johann G. C. Storl's dates (died 1719) are from https://www.deutsche-biographie.de/sfz81607.html (Störl, Johann Georg Christian, um 1676 - 1719); CCEH's page gives none. Henry John Gauntlett's dates (1805–1876) are from our page for the tune IRBY (content/hymns/tunes/irby.json); CCEH's page gives only the year 1861. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000034a.nwc).
